name.fr-FR: Entretiens de saint Vincent de Paul aux Filles de la Charité
name.en-US: Conferences of St. Vincent de Paul to the Daughters of Charity
name.pt-BR: Colóquios de São Vicente de Paulo às Filhas da Caridade

description.fr-FR: Les conférences et entretiens de saint Vincent aux Filles de la Charité (1634-1660), recueillis par les sœurs et édités par Pierre Coste (tomes IX-X) : le règlement, l’esprit de la compagnie, l’humilité, la charité, la prière, le service des pauvres, avec les notes de l’éditeur.
description.en-US: The conferences of St. Vincent to the Daughters of Charity (1634-1660), taken down by the sisters and edited by Pierre Coste (vols. IX-X): the rule, the spirit of the company, humility, charity, prayer, the service of the poor, with the editor’s notes.
description.pt-BR: As conferências de São Vicente às Filhas da Caridade (1634-1660), recolhidas pelas irmãs e editadas por Pierre Coste (tomos IX-X): a regra, o espírito da companhia, a humildade, a caridade, a oração, o serviço dos pobres.

sources.edition: Saint Vincent de Paul, Correspondance, entretiens, documents, éd. Pierre Coste C.M., Paris: Gabalda, 1920-1925, tomes IX-X; digital edition by P. Claude Lautissier C.M. and the Daughters of Charity (1992), on JesusMarie.com.
sources.description: All conferences of Coste’s tomes IX and X, one per chapter, with Coste’s headnotes and footnotes kept as notes (and the notes of the later Vincentian editors in angle brackets). Coste’s introduction is not included.
sources.tierEvidence: Vincent died in 1660; Coste’s edition appeared in 1920-25 and Coste died in 1935. The digital transcription is of the same text, with Coste’s notes.
